reviewNotes: Reviewed English/Romanian pairs for parrot clipped speech, island actions, perfection statistics, easter-egg humor and race announcements. Walnut amounts use label-first parrot speech to avoid obligatory Romanian de varying with dynamic number. Preserved stars, special perfection icon ¾ and all parameters. Explicit proper nouns from glossary retained; numeric percentage format preserved with reason. Runtime CharacterCustomization confirms EasterEgg6 uses an empty article for a custom locale; compact adjacent article/name tokens are intentional.
